data.title: test(store): retry poll_once_then_drop cancellation setup until provably in-flight (bn-3c6a)
data.description: Fixes the flaky shared setup in crates/mess-store/tests/engine_publish_cancel.rs and crates/mess-store/tests/owned_append.rs. poll_once_then_drop now returns Option<F::Output>; a bounded drop_in_flight(mk_future) -> attempts wrapper retries the fresh-append/poll-once/drop setup until an attempt is provably Pending (cap 50, loud panic otherwise). Attempts that completed are ordinary appends, so all exact expectations are derived from the attempt count (heads At(2*attempts), delivered totals, pre/post-drop Conflict versions, read lengths, borrowed_batches/borrowed_records). The new-name owned test uses a fresh stream name per attempt and checks every attempt's stream survives the reopen. Evidence: 20/20 nextest iterations of both binaries green; 144/144 parallel binary runs at load avg 24 green with the retry path naturally firing 11 times; forced-completion instrumentation (1-3 synthetic completed attempts) green on all 5 tests, and mutating the derived counts back to hardcoded values fails as it should.
